title: Taphnes
summary: Raleigh names Taphnes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Taphnes, sister of the wife of the King of Aegypt, giuen in marriage to Adad the Idumaean. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IX, §. II, sig. 237b
